items.name: Mochis Cream
items.notes: Postre items are laid out in paired rows (8001 left / 8002 right, 8003 left / 8004 right, then Dorayaki centred), so they are listed in numeric/row order.

items.name: Tarta de queso vasca de Matcha
items.notes: Name printed on two lines: "Tarta de queso" / "vasca de Matcha".

items.name: Helados
items.description: Sabores: té matcha , judía roja y sésamo.
items.notes: Description printed with a space before the comma ("té matcha , judía roja"). No sesame icon is printed even though sésamo is listed as a flavour.

items.name: Dorayaki
items.notes: The number 8003 is printed twice on this page: it is used for both Tarta de queso vasca de Matcha and Dorayaki (probably meant to be 8005). Dorayaki is centred at the bottom of the page.

otherText: FUERA DE BUFFET (red banner at top of page)
